channel.title: Exact incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Exact's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Exact Online Fiscaal - Declarations are rejected with a general rejection reason (NL) [identified]
item.description: The issue has been identified. Due to a disruption at Logius Digipoort, declarations cannot be processed. Logius is investigating this issue.

item.title: Exact Synergy - Word pop-up blocked in 64-bit (Global) [investigating]
item.description: You may notice that the Exact Synergy add-in blocks Word pop-ups when working in 64-bit. We are investigating this issue. This page will be updated as soon as more information becomes available. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Multivers / Exact Boekhoud Gemak - Rabobank mutations not received (NL) [identified]
item.description: You may notice that you are not receiving Rabobank statements for your active bank links. The issue has been identified, and we are working on a solution. Please refrain from manually importing the statements, as we will ensure that the statements will be imported. We will update this page as soon as more information is available. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online - Emails delayed or not delivered (Global) [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved. All queued messages have been delivered and new messages will be delivered without unexpected delay. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Gripp - Emails delayed or not getting delivered to Microsoft mail-domains (NL/BE) [resolved]
item.description: The issue at Microsoft is resolved. All queued messages have been delivered in the meantime and new messages will be delivered without delay. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Reeleezee – Rabobank Bank Transaction Import Delay [resolved]
item.description:
This issue has been resolved. The transactions from the affected period have now been successfully imported for most customers. For a small number of customers, the remaining transactions are expected to be imported later today. If you notice that some historical transactions are still missing tomorrow, you can retrieve them manually.
First, please try selecting "Retrieve Transactions" via "Manage Bank Connection" from your bank account settings in Reeleezee. If the missing transactions are still not displayed, you can download a CAMT.053 file containing the missing transactions from your online banking environment and import it into Reeleezee via the bank overview. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online - Temporarily unavailable (Global) [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved. All Exact Online environments are available and work as intended again. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online - EOL app 7.3 - Warning 'Invalid: Execution date' (NL) [identified]
item.description: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.

item.title: Exact Online - Unable to export to Excel through overviews (Global) [identified]
item.description:
This issue occurs when the company name contains a comma (,). In addition, the issue appears to affect Google Chrome and has not been reported in other browsers.
As a workaround, you can either: - Remove the comma from the company name, or - Perform the export using a different browser than Google Chrome.
We continue to investigate the underlying cause and will update this page as soon as more information becomes available.

item.title: Exact Online - Purchase invoices do not come through to digital postbox (NL/BE) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved and the purchase invoices that were sent have now been received in the digital postbox.

item.title: Exact Multivers - Unable to login to Multivers (NL) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online Fiscaal - Foreign income not taken into account in order to allocate IACK to correct partner in IB (C) 2025 (NL) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online - New SSO users can't be created (Global) [identified]
item.description: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.

item.title: Exact Online Fiscaal - Incorrect percentage 'Premie AOW' when enabling 'In het buitenland verzekerd voor de sociale zekerheid' (NL) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved and the percentage for 'Premie AOW' is correct again in this scenario. We urge you to verify whether the tax return has been correctly filled in according to the requirements of the Tax Authorities. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Multivers - Password result mails are not received (NL) [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact HR & Salaris Gemak / Exact Venice / Exact Multivers / Exact Cloud Services - SMS-authentication disabled as two factor authentication method (Global) [identified]
item.description: On certain occasions, the migration to Microsoft Authenticator cannot be executed. In those cases, you can perform a reset of your two factor authentication (2FA) by opening an InPrivate/Incognito browser session and complete the setup via Microsoft Security Information Setup.

item.title: Exact Online - E-invoice subscription status shows incorrect status on company settings page (FR) [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved. From now on, when updating your E-invoice subscription, the status will be updated. If the E-invoice subscription status is currently incorrect you can correct it by deactivating and reactivating an option in the subscription. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Multivers & Exact Boekhoudgemak - Invoices sent through API are not correctly updated [resolved]
item.description: The API update (V1) has been rolled back, meaning the previous situation is now restored. The issues should not present themselves anymore. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Globe+ - Excel Add-In returns error when started on Office build 2608. [identified]
item.description: We have identified that the current issue is resolved in Microsoft Excel Version 2609, which is currently available only in the Beta Channel. In the meantime, customers in the Current Channel using Unicode languages may still experience display issues in certain Excel Add-in screens. We will update this page as soon as more information becomes available.

item.title: Exact Bouw - No synchronisation between Bouw and Exact Online (NL/BE) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online - Unable to select option Receive in e-invoice subscription (FR) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online - Deduplication not finding double accounts (NL/BE) [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved. When using the deduplication button the expected double accounts are shown again. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online Premium - Degraded performance (Global) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online Fiscaal & Jaarrekening - Client relationship reactivation has not been saved (NL) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved and you can set the client relationship to "Tot op heden" again. The client will also be visible again in the client overview with an active client relationship if the end date is set in the future or is set to "Tot op heden". Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Globe+ / Exact Globe Next / Exact Synergy - Degraded performance when downloading or updating the products. [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Exact Online Bouw - Data is not synchronizing between Exact Online Bouw and Exact Online (NL/BE) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Globe+ - license migration wizard returns message "License update failed" (Global) [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Exact Multivers/Exact Boekhoud Gemak - Invoices imported via API remain pending (NL) [resolved]
item.description: The issue with approving invoices in Exact Multivers Online and Exact Boekhoud Gemak has been resolved. Invoices can be approved as usual again. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Globe Next - Exact Globe+ - Exact Synergy - Exact ELIS - Not possible to update the license or software. [resolved]
item.description: This issue is now resolved.

item.title: Exact Online Fiscaal – Invalid error message when modifying client details on a client card (NL) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. If you have temporarily enabled the right “koppelingen instellen” in the category “algemeen account” as a workaround, we advise you to disable this right again. Our apologies for the inconvenience.
